links.outcome: Full CAD-RADS categorization accuracy of LLMs versus human readers on same reports
links.effect: O1 90.7% accuracy vs GPT-4o 73.8%, GPT-4 59.7%, GPT-3.5-turbo 25.8%, fellow 83.3%, resident 1 83.3%; no significant difference vs cardiac radiologist (86.1%; P = 0.12) and resident 2 (89.4%; P = 0.68).
links.quote: However, there was no significant difference in accuracy when compared to the cardiac radiologist (86.1%; P = 0.12) and resident 2 (89.4%; P = 0.68).

links.outcome: O1 accuracy on external validation dataset from two independent institutions
links.effect: O1 achieved 95.7% accuracy for full CAD-RADS categorization in the external validation dataset (n = 327).
links.quote: In the external validation dataset (n = 327) derived from two independent institutions, O1 achieved 95.7% accuracy for full CAD-RADS categorization.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and processing speed of multiple LLMs (including OpenAI o1 and GPT-4o) compared to human readers (radiologists/residents) on extracting CAD-RADS categories from CCTA reports, without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
